on_screen_text.text: Greg Abbott has this legislator locked in the Texas House??

TIME Texas Democrat Locked in State Capitol for Refusing Mandatory Escort Rep. Nicole Collier is one of dozens of Democrats who fled Texas earlier this month to block a vote on a Trump-backed redistricting plan.

“I refuse to sign away my dignity as a duly elected representative just so Republicans can control my movements and monitor me with police escorts,” Collier said in a statement to media outlets. “My constituents sent me to Austin to protect their voices and rights,” she said. “When I press that button to vote, I know these maps will harm my constituents—I won’t just go along quietly with their intimidation or their discrimination.”

central_claim: Texas Republicans, led by Governor Greg Abbott, are using authoritarian intimidation tactics to force through a discriminatory, Trump-backed redistricting plan, to the point of locking a Democratic legislator in the State Capitol.
intended_effect: To provoke outrage at Greg Abbott and Texas Republicans and to build sympathy and support for Democratic legislator Nicole Collier.
